en: Dependent on an internal wholesome state... (Abbreviated; similar to the "two minds" section.
Dependent on an external wholesome state, a state that is neither unwholesome nor external arises by way of root condition...
three. (Abbreviated. Nine for root... pe... three for result... pe... nine for non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is not derived (*anupādā*), a wholesome state that is not derived arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not derived, a state that is neither wholesome nor not derived arises by way of root condition.
... Three. (Abbreviated. Fifteen under root, fifteen under predominance; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... fifteen under non-disappearance.
Dependent on an indeterminate, appropriated dhamma, an unwholesome, non-appropriated dhamma arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate, appropriated dhamma, an unwholesome, non-appropriated dhamma arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate, appropriated dhamma, both an unwholesome, non-appropriated dhamma and a neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome, non-appropriated dhamma arise [by way of root condition].
Dhammas arise with root condition... three. Under root [condition], there are three...
pe ... under non-disappearance [condition], there are three.
